body:
Reproduced in a second, unrelated app, and on a much older Wails.

Our production build of DNClient Desktop links `wails/v3@v3.0.0-alpha.10` and was compiled on 2026-09-01, well before #5919 and #6026. On macOS 27.0 (26A428) it shows the same defect: right clicking an open tray menu often fails to dismiss it. So this is not introduced by anything recent in the systray code.

One important difference from the toy reproduction: on that older build the behaviour is **not deterministic**. Sometimes the second right click dismisses the menu, sometimes it closes and reopens. In the reproduction app on `master` all seven consecutive right clicks reopened. That points at a race rather than a deterministic code path, which fits the 18-23 ms close-to-reopen gaps already reported: `menuDidClose:` clears `statusItem.menu` and the button returns to action mode, and whether the dismissing mouse down is then handled as a fresh click appears to depend on timing.

Worth noting for anyone testing on that older build: left click does nothing at all there, since it predates #5919, so right click is the only way to open the menu and the only way to dismiss it is unreliable.

Both apps are pure menu trays, so `applySmartDefaults` installs `ShowMenu` as the right click handler and the monitor's native tracking path is unreachable for right click on every macOS version.

Amended the title and the Expected behaviour section above. The original framing was wrong and I would rather correct it than have someone else find it.

Right click not dismissing an open menu bar menu is normal macOS behaviour, not a bug: a system managed SwiftUI `MenuBarExtra` on this same machine and OS (27.0, 26A428) behaves the same way. What is wrong here is narrower. Wails closes the menu and reopens it about 20 ms later rather than ignoring the click, which the trace shows directly as `menuDidClose:` followed by a fresh `showMenu`. That is a visible flicker and it tears down and rebuilds menu state for no reason.

The intermittency on the older alpha.10 build supports the narrower reading: a stable "ignore the click" path would never sometimes dismiss.
Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.
